source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the synthesis of alcohols (PDF 91-92).

blocks.text: Alcohols alkenes, halogenoalkanes, carbonyl compounds, carboxylic acids aur esters se banaye ja sakte hain.

items: Alkenes aur bhaap se: garam bhaap alkene se, garhe phosphoric acid catalyst ke saath, electrophilic addition se react karti hai: CH2=CH2 + H2O(g) -> CH3CH2OH (H3PO4, garmi).
Alkenes aur thande halke KMnO4 se: yeh narm oxidising agent diol deta hai: CH2=CH2 + H2O + [O] -> HOCH2CH2OH (ethane-1,2-diol).
Halogenoalkanes se: aabi NaOH ke saath garam karne par halogen ki jagah -OH aata hai: CH3CH2Br + NaOH -> CH3CH2OH + NaBr.

Aldehydes aur ketones ko NaBH4 ya LiAlH4 se reduce kar ke: aldehydes primary alcohols dete hain, maslan CH3CHO + 2[H] -> CH3CH2OH; ketones secondary alcohols, maslan CH3COCH3 + 2[H] -> CH3CH(OH)CH3 (propan-2-ol).
Carboxylic acids ko LiAlH4 se reduce kar ke, primary alcohols: CH3COOH + 4[H] -> CH3CH2OH + H2O.
Esters ki hydrolysis se: halke tezaab ya alkali ke saath garam karne par carboxylic acid aur alcohol bante hain: CH3COOCH2CH3 + H2O <=> CH3COOH + CH3CH2OH (H+).

blocks.alt: Khuli banawat wali ethene + H2O(g), teer ke oopar H3PO4 aur neeche heat (garmi), se khuli banawat wala ethanol. Labels: ethene, steam (bhaap), ethanol.
blocks.caption: i) Ethene aur bhaap se ethanol (kitab ke PDF safha 91 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Khuli banawat wali ethene + H2O + [O], teer ke oopar KMnO4 aur neeche OH-, se khuli banawat wala ethane-1,2-diol, HO-CH2-CH2-OH. Labels: ethene, ethane-1,2-diol.
blocks.caption: ii) Thande, halke KMnO4 se alkenes ki oxidation se diol (kitab ke PDF safha 91 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Khuli banawat wala bromoethane + NaOH, teer ke oopar Heat (garmi), se khuli banawat wala ethanol + NaBr. Labels: bromoethane, ethanol.
blocks.caption: iii) Bromoethane aur aabi sodium hydroxide se ethanol (kitab ke PDF safha 92 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Do mua'adle, teer ke oopar LiAlH4. Khuli banawat wala ethanal (C=O ke saath H) + 2[H] se ethanol (primary alcohol). Khuli banawat wala propanone (teen carbons ke beech C=O) + 2[H] se propan-2-ol, darmiyani carbon par OH (secondary alcohol).
blocks.caption: iv) Ethanal aur propanone ki reduction (kitab ke PDF safha 92 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Aldehyde (ethanal) mein C=O zanjeer ke sire par hai, is liye do H milne par -CH2OH, yani primary alcohol, banta hai. Ketone (propanone) mein C=O beech mein hai, is liye -CH(OH)-, yani secondary alcohol, banta hai. Kitab ne 'secondary alchol' chhapa hai; sahi hijje 'alcohol' hain.

blocks.alt: Khuli banawat wala ethanoic acid (C=O ke saath OH) + 4[H], teer ke oopar LiAlH4, se khuli banawat wala ethanol + H2O. Labels: ethanoic acid, ethanol.
blocks.caption: v) Ethanoic acid ki reduction se ethanol (kitab ke PDF safha 92 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: CH3-C(=O)-O-CH2-CH3 + H2O, equilibrium teeron ke oopar H+(aq), se CH3-C(=O)-OH + CH3-CH2-OH. Labels: ethyl ethanoate, ethanoic acid.
blocks.caption: vi) Ethyl ethanoate ki hydrolysis (kitab ke PDF safha 92 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa reducing agent carboxylic acid ko alcohol mein reduce kar sakta hai, aur kis qism ka alcohol banta hai?
blocks.explanation: LiAlH4; primary alcohol (maslan ethanoic acid se ethanol).

items: Alkene + bhaap (H3PO4) -> alcohol; alkene + thanda halka KMnO4 -> diol.
RX + NaOH(aq) -> ROH; aldehyde -> 1 alcohol, ketone -> 2 alcohol (NaBH4/LiAlH4); tezaab -> 1 alcohol (LiAlH4).
